summary: The exact candidate was rebuilt and independently confirms a partial implementation of grpc.health.v1 Health beside the native service. It does not implement the original issue's multimodal transport/coverage or RL lifecycle contract. Its Check behavior and ordinary registered-service transitions work, but its Watch behavior does not fully conform to the protocol contract: it emits duplicate responses while status is unchanged, and Watch for an unknown service terminates with NOT_FOUND rather than returning SERVICE_UNKNOWN and keeping the stream open. Request changes before accepting even the standard-health portion.

tests.command: Base: cargo +1.92.0 build --release --locked -p sglang-grpc; load /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f18e41a65082/base-target/release/libsglang_grpc_core.so and call grpc.health.v1.Health/Check
tests.what_was_measured: A native rebuild from recorded base 358c163250ad3b1f62939b01ce1314a0a31a0365 reproduced the original standard-health gap: Check returned UNIMPLEMENTED.
Rebuilt the exact candidate's optimized native library; subsequent live tests loaded /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-f18e41a65082/candidate-target/release/libsglang_grpc_core.so.
Candidate regression plus compatibility test: 6 passed and 2 subtests passed against the rebuilt native artifact.

Independent live grpcio checks verified initial NOT_SERVING, false-to-true recovery, exception-to-NOT_SERVING recovery, clean poller shutdown, duplicate unchanged Watch emissions, and NOT_FOUND termination for unknown-service Watch.
Candidate Rust targets passed clippy with warnings denied after adding the pinned toolchain's clippy component.

gpu_evidence: No GPU execution was appropriate for this control-plane-only candidate. The node exposes one AMD Instinct MI350X (gfx950) through Torch 2.11.0+rocm7.2 / HIP 7.2, but the candidate contains no GPU numerical path.
remaining_counterexamples: With engine health held constant at NOT_SERVING, Watch receives another NOT_SERVING response on the next one-second poll. The protocol says Watch sends another response when serving status changes; unconditional publication creates duplicate unchanged events.

Watch for never.registered.Service terminates with gRPC NOT_FOUND. The bundled grpc.health.v1 proto requires a SERVICE_UNKNOWN response without terminating the call so a later registration can be observed.
Native gRPC multimodal image, audio, and video inputs remain unimplemented and unverified, including aggregated and encoder-disaggregated coverage.
RL operations and explicit pause/drain, weight-update, ready-to-serve, and resume lifecycle semantics remain unimplemented and unverified.
remaining_limitations: No model server, model weights, multimodal architecture, encoder-disaggregated deployment, RL workload, or distributed workload was exercised because the candidate does not implement those original-issue portions.
The prepared environment initially lacked Rust; Rust 1.92.0 and clippy were installed under the private job runtime without changing the pinned Torch/ROCm stack.
No inference or GPU numerical claim is made. Testing was x86_64 Linux native control-plane execution on an AMD MI350X host.
